task.title: Accessible dependency map
task.goal: Fix the obvious missed acceptance criterion: this feature is described as interactive but currently renders static text. Add a keyboard-accessible button and real event listener, plus explicit uncertainty. Preserve the useful explanation. Create an accessible interactive outline explaining the internal connections needed to turn a local civic concern into responsible next steps, clearly labeling uncertain or unverified links. No external network requests.

steps: Build one accessible, self-contained UI component
